testcase.system-out: Scenario: Transfer a source command after clicking the empty target list ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And ribbon customization shows All Commands and an empty Part Tools target ✔ When the user selects "2D Sketches" in the available commands list ✔ And the user clicks an empty area of the target list ✔ Then "2D Sketches" remains highlighted in the available commands list ✔ And the target list remains empty ✔ And Apply remains disabled ✔ When the user clicks the add command button ✔ Then "2D Sketches" appears in the target list ✔ And the target shows a pending-change marker ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And the Tools ribbon remains visible
